ai_overview.text: Excessive sweating, or hyperhidrosis, is treated in Guntur through specialized dermatology clinics and multi-specialty hospitals like Aster Ramesh Hospital in Nagarampalem and Dr. Pooja's B18 Skin Clinic in Panduranga Nagar . Care options range from prescription antiperspirants and oral medications to advanced clinical procedures like Botox injections. Instagram · b18skinclinic +2 Available Treatments Topical options: Prescription-strength antiperspirants and creams containing glycopyrrolate. Medications: Oral nerve-blocking or anticholinergic pills to reduce overall sweat production. Injections: Botox (botulinum toxin) injections to safely block nerve signals in target areas like the underarms, palms, or soles. Advanced care: Energy-based devices or laser treatments available through specialized aesthetic dermatology centres.
